title: Campus Library Conversation
source: IELTop original sample content, released with the app. Replace with licensed material and audio.
transcript: Student: Excuse me, what time does the library open on weekdays? Librarian: We open at eight every weekday morning, and at ten on weekends. Student: Great. Can I borrow a laptop? Librarian: Yes, you can borrow one for two hours at a time. If you need it longer, just renew it at the desk.

questions.prompt: What time does the library open on weekdays?
How long can a student borrow a laptop?
What should a student do to keep a laptop longer?
